"""Command line entry point: python -m tidyshelf.cli <command>."""
import argparse
import sys

from . import storage
from .items import Item

DEFAULT_DB = "shelf.json"


def build_parser():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tidyshelf")
    p.add_argument("--db", default=DEFAULT_DB)
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    a = sub.add_parser("add", help="add stock for an item")
    a.add_argument("sku")
    a.add_argument("name")
    a.add_argument("--qty", type=int, default=1)
    a.add_argument("--location", default="unsorted")
    r = sub.add_parser("remove", help="remove stock")
    r.add_argument("sku")
    r.add_argument("--qty", type=int, default=1)
    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all items")
    return p


def main(argv=None, out=sys.stdout):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "add":
            item = storage.add_item(args.db, Item(args.sku, args.name, args.qty, args.location))
            print(f"{item.sku}: {item.qty} in stock", file=out)
        elif args.command == "remove":
            item = storage.remove_qty(args.db, args.sku, args.qty)
            print(f"{item.sku}: {item.qty} in stock", file=out)
        else:
            for sku, item in sorted(storage.load(args.db).items()):
                print(f"{sku}\t{item.name}\t{item.qty}\t{item.location}", file=out)
    except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

1	"""Item model and validation."""
2	from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
3	
4	
5	@dataclass
6	class Item:
7	    sku: str
8	    name: str
9	    qty: int = 0
10	    location: str = "unsorted"
11	
12	    def to_dict(self):
13	        return asdict(self)
14	
15	
16	def validate(item: Item) -> None:
17	    if not item.sku or " " in item.sku:
18	        raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty and contain no spaces")
19	    if not item.name.strip():
20	        raise ValueError("name must not be empty")
21	    if item.qty < 0:
22	        raise ValueError("qty must not be negative")

1	"""JSON-file storage. The file path is passed in, never hard-coded."""
2	import json
3	from pathlib import Path
4	
5	from .items import Item, validate
6	
7	
8	def load(path):
9	    p = Path(path)
10	    if not p.exists():
11	        return {}
12	    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
13	    return {sku: Item(**row) for sku, row in data.items()}
14	
15	
16	def save(path, inventory):
17	    data = {sku: item.to_dict() for sku, item in sorted(inventory.items())}
18	    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
19	
20	
21	def add_item(path, item: Item):
22	    validate(item)
23	    inv = load(path)
24	    if item.sku in inv:
25	        inv[item.sku].qty += item.qty
26	    else:
27	        inv[item.sku] = item
28	    save(path, inv)
29	    return inv[item.sku]
30	
31	
32	def remove_qty(path, sku, qty):
33	    inv = load(path)
34	    if sku not in inv:
35	        raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
36	    if qty > inv[sku].qty:
37	        raise ValueError("not enough stock")
38	    inv[sku].qty -= qty
39	    save(path, inv)
40	    return inv[sku]
